correctness.rationale: The spanning-tree monomial enumeration is exact. A primitive-linear Gauss argument establishes irreducibility of all F_s, s>=2. Case analysis for 0,1,2,>=3 vanishing pair sums gives the entire reduced singular support; dense opens distinguish m+binom(m,3) components. Projective degrees add to m^2+binom(m,3). The two explicitly computed transverse quadratic Hessians have nonzero determinants in characteristic zero. Serre S2+R1 gives normality. Exact finite-field projective checker passed but is not a substitute for these proofs.
